slides.texte_overlay:
Unusual hobbies that make you
more attractive
Learn to dance, even a little. Salsa, swing, anything with a partner. Six classes and you'll stop dreading weddings. A guy who can lead a simple dance is rare, and people love it.
Take up photography with a real camera. You learn to notice light, faces and small moments. And the photos you take of friends end up on their walls for years.
Learn to cook bread from scratch. Flour, water, salt, time. It's slow, calming, and showing up somewhere with a warm loaf you made yourself makes a huge impression on anyone.
Try rock climbing. It builds real strength, teaches you to stay calm under pressure, and climbing gyms are full of friendly people. It's a social hobby that also gets you in shape.
Learn a few magic tricks. Card tricks, coin tricks, nothing fancy. Two minutes of practice a day. It's the easiest icebreaker at a party, and kids, friends and dates all love it.
Write by hand. A journal, letters, a few lines each night. It slows your mind, sharpens your thinking, and a handwritten note to someone you care about feels like a small gift.
Try this for 30 days: five minutes a day of history, art or science. It's the hobby that makes all the others more interesting, and it gives you something new to share every day.
